# Data Source fcp_services

Retrieves fcp service data

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_fcp_services" "protocols_fcp_services" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "cluster1"
  filter = {
    svm_name = "svm*"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name

### Optional

- `filter` (Attributes) Filter FC Protocol services by their properties (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Read-Only

- `fcp_services` (Attributes List) FC Protocol services matching the filter (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fcp_services))

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>

### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `svm_name` (String) FC Protocol SVM name

<a id="nestedatt--fcp_services"></a>

### Nested Schema for `fcp_services`

Read-Only:

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `enabled` (Boolean) The administrative state of the FC Protocol service
- `id` (String) FC Protocol service SVM UUID
- `svm_name` (String) FC Protocol SVM name
